item.title: Former WBRC sports anchor, husband found dead in apparent murder-suicide, Hoover police say; Toddler found alive
item.description: The Hoover Police Department is investigating a tragic scene after a toddler was found inside a home where her parents were deceased. Police responded to the scene in the 700 block of Highland Court at 9:03 a.m. A family member of the couple discovered the man and woman unresponsive inside the home.The three-year-old child was at the scene and was unharmed.Hoover Fire-Medics responded and pronounced the couple dead from apparent gunshot wounds.
